screen.redcircuit.gate.desc.not: Front, left and right are on when the back input is off. Side outputs can be switched off.
screen.redcircuit.gate.desc.buffer: Repeats the back input to the front, left and right (isolates and refreshes a signal). Side outputs can be switched off.
screen.redcircuit.gate.desc.and: Output is on when all enabled inputs (left, back, right) are on. Disabled inputs are ignored; the back one is disabled by default.
screen.redcircuit.gate.desc.nand: Output is off only when all enabled inputs (left, back, right) are on. The back input is disabled by default.
screen.redcircuit.gate.desc.or: Output is on when any enabled input (left, back, right) is on.
screen.redcircuit.gate.desc.nor: Output is on when no enabled input (left, back, right) is on.
screen.redcircuit.gate.desc.xor: Output is on when exactly one of the left and right inputs is on.
screen.redcircuit.gate.desc.xnor: Output is on when the left and right inputs are equal (both on or both off).
screen.redcircuit.gate.desc.rs_latch: Remembers one bit. The set input turns the front on, the reset input turns the back on - one of them is always lit.
screen.redcircuit.gate.desc.toggle: A pulse on the left or right input switches the output between front and back. Right-click toggles by hand, Shift + right-click opens this window.
screen.redcircuit.gate.desc.pulse: A rising edge at the back gives a short pulse at the front.
screen.redcircuit.gate.desc.timer: Pulses the front, left and right sides every set time. A signal at the back stops it.
screen.redcircuit.gate.desc.randomizer: While the back is powered, the front, left and right outputs each turn on or off at random.
screen.redcircuit.gate.desc.counter: Left counts up, right counts down. Front is on at the maximum, back is on at zero.
screen.redcircuit.gate.desc.sequencer: Lights each side in turn: front, right, back, left. A signal at the back pauses it.
screen.redcircuit.gate.desc.state_cell: A pulse at the back starts the countdown; the side output is on while counting, then the front pulses.
screen.redcircuit.gate.desc.synchronizer: Waits for a pulse on both left and right, then pulses the front. Back resets.
jei.redcircuit.info.thermopile: Generates power from a temperature difference. Each hot neighbour (lava, fire, magma, lit campfire) paired with a cold one (water, ice, snow) gives 8 FE/t, up to 24 FE/t.
jei.redcircuit.info.generator: Needs a rotor mounted on its front: right-click with a Windmill or Water Wheel. Shift + right-click with an empty hand removes it.
jei.redcircuit.info.windmill: Mount on a Generator. Needs a free 5x5 area in front, open to the sky. 6 FE/t at sea level, up to 32 FE/t high up; x1.5 in rain, x2 in thunderstorms.
jei.redcircuit.info.water_wheel: Mount on a Generator. Flowing water in the 3x3 area in front gives 4 FE/t per block, still water 1 FE/t (max 24 FE/t).
jei.redcircuit.info.pump: Place it by clicking the fluid source (tank or lake): it sucks from the back and pushes to the front (another mod's tank/pipe, or pours the fluid out). 200 FE per bucket. A redstone signal stops it.
jei.redcircuit.info.fluid_pipe: Carries fluids between the Pump and tanks/machines (also from other mods). Pipes level out among themselves and push fluid into every connected tank except the one it came from. 1000 mB per pipe, up to 250 mB/t per side.
jei.redcircuit.info.screwdriver: Right-click a block to rotate it: gates, machines, pumps, extractors and vanilla blocks with a direction (e.g. repeaters, observers, hoppers, logs). Shift + right-click rotates the other way; on a logic gate it picks the gate up together with its settings (time, counter maximum, disabled inputs, mute). Does not open GUIs or change the timer interval. Never wears out.
jei.redcircuit.info.wire_cutters: Crafting tool for making fine wire: ingot + wire cutters = fine wire (copper or iron). Stays in the grid and loses 1 durability. Made from steel; repair with a steel ingot.
jei.redcircuit.info.battery: Portable Azurity storage (50,000 FE). Put it in the battery slot of the Electric Furnace or Power Alloy Furnace to power them. In the Battery Box: top slot charges, bottom slot discharges (or right-click / Shift + right-click the box). Works with other mods' FE chargers.
jei.redcircuit.info.encased_wire: Wire in a hard casing that runs through the middle of the block, like a pipe. Connects to wires of the same kind (also wall-mounted ones) and works exactly like them. 8 wires around a smooth stone slab = 8 encased wires; a encased wire alone in the grid gives the plain wire back.
jei.redcircuit.info.requester: Place it by clicking a tube: the back connects to the tube network, the front is the output. On a redstone pulse it searches every inventory connected to that network, pulls an item matching the filter (empty filter = anything) and the item travels through the tubes to the Requester, which pushes it out the front. Filter slots are used in turn; the stack size in a slot sets how many items to fetch. 200 FE per pull. Right-click: filter, Shift + right-click: energy.
jei.redcircuit.info.manager: Place it by clicking the inventory to manage; the front connects to a tube network. The filter lists items with amounts: missing items are ordered from inventories on the network, items not on the list are sent back to the network. 100 FE per order. Shift + right-click: energy.
jei.redcircuit.info.regulator: Moves items from the inventory behind into the inventory in front until it holds the amounts set in the filter. Emits a redstone signal when everything is supplied.
jei.redcircuit.info.relay: 9-slot buffer: accepts items from every side except the front and keeps pushing them out the front (tube, inventory or the ground).
jei.redcircuit.info.item_detector: Put it into a tube line (back = in, front = out). Every stack passing through sends a short redstone pulse.
jei.redcircuit.info.igniter: While powered, lights a fire in front of it and keeps it burning; turning the signal off puts the fire out.
jei.redcircuit.info.assembler: Controlled by bundled cable: turning channel N on places the block from slot N in front, turning it off collects that block back into slot N. A plain redstone pulse places the next block or collects the one in front.
jei.redcircuit.info.ejector: 9 slots; on each redstone pulse pushes one stack out the front (slots in turn).
jei.redcircuit.info.deployer: 9 slots; on a redstone pulse uses an item on the block in front like a player's right-click (places blocks, bone meal, buckets, shears...).
jei.redcircuit.info.buffer: 18-slot storage accessible from every side by tubes and hoppers. Comparators read how full it is.
jei.redcircuit.info.block_breaker: On a redstone pulse breaks the block in front (like a diamond pickaxe); the drops go out the back - into a tube, inventory or onto the ground.
jei.redcircuit.info.lamp: Lights up with a redstone signal (also from RedCircuit wires next to it). The inverted lamp works the other way round: it is lit without a signal. Lamp + redstone torch switches between normal and inverted.
jei.redcircuit.info.counter: Left input (rising edge) counts up, right counts down. The front is on at the maximum, the back is on at zero. Right-click opens settings: maximum (1-1024) and reset. A comparator reads the current count.
jei.redcircuit.info.sequencer: Outputs a signal on each side in turn: front, right, back, left - one step per set time. A signal at the back pauses it. Right-click opens settings (step time).
jei.redcircuit.info.state_cell: A pulse at the back starts the countdown: the right side is on while counting, then the front gives a short pulse. Right-click opens settings (time).
jei.redcircuit.info.synchronizer: Waits for a pulse on both the left and the right input (in any order), then gives a pulse at the front. A signal at the back resets it.
jei.redcircuit.info.restriction_tube: Works like a normal tube, but routing treats it as very long: items only take it when there is no other way to the target. Restriction tube alone in the grid gives the tube back.
jei.redcircuit.info.accelerator: A tube segment powered with FE: every stack passing through is boosted to 4x speed and then slows down gradually over the next tubes. 20 FE per stack (configurable). Right-click shows energy.
jei.redcircuit.info.wireless_transmitter: Place it on a block. Right-click sets the frequency (1-5000). While it receives a redstone signal it transmits on that frequency - everywhere, also in other dimensions and unloaded chunks.
jei.redcircuit.info.wireless_receiver: Right-click sets the frequency. Outputs a redstone signal (15) on all sides while any transmitter or remote is active on its frequency.
jei.redcircuit.info.wireless_remote: Hold right-click to transmit on its frequency (like holding a button). Shift + right-click sets the frequency.
jei.redcircuit.info.fluid_tank: Holds 16 buckets of one fluid. Right-click with a bucket to fill or empty it, with an empty hand to see the contents. Pipes and pumps connect from every side; fluid flows down into a tank placed below. Keeps its contents when broken. Comparators read the level, glowing fluids (lava) give light.
jei.redcircuit.info.sawmill: Cuts logs and stems into 6 planks (instead of 4) plus sawdust, and planks into 3 sticks. Uses 12 FE/t; has a battery slot. Sawdust burns in furnaces and 3 sawdust make 2 paper. Custom recipes: type redcircuit:sawing.
jei.redcircuit.info.macerator: Grinds ores and raw ores into 2 dusts (10% chance of a third), ingots into 1 dust, and also cobblestone, gravel, bones, blaze rods, wool and more. Dusts smelt into ingots. Uses 16 FE/t; has a battery slot. Hoppers insert from any side and take results out. Custom recipes: type redcircuit:macerating.
jei.redcircuit.info.solid_fuel_generator: Burns anything that works in a furnace (coal, wood, lava buckets...) and makes 20 FE/t while burning: one coal gives 32,000 FE. Pushes energy into neighbouring blocks (400 FE/t per side). Stops burning when its 20,000 FE buffer is full or when it gets a redstone signal. Hoppers insert fuel from the top/sides; empty buckets come out of the bottom.
jei.redcircuit.info.charger: Charges up to 4 items with FE (batteries, electric tools, items from other mods) at 1000 FE/t each. Power it with power wire. Hoppers insert from the top/sides and take out fully charged items from the bottom.
jei.redcircuit.info.electric_drill: Pickaxe + shovel at diamond level that uses energy instead of durability: 50 FE per block (100,000 FE). Without energy it digs very slowly. Shift + right-click switches between 1x1 and 3x3 mining (3x3 is slower and uses energy for every block; hold Shift while mining to break a single block).
jei.redcircuit.info.electric_chainsaw: Axe that also cuts leaves, wool and cobwebs; uses 50 FE per block, strong attack. Without energy it is very slow.
jei.redcircuit.info.multimeter: Right-click a block: redstone signal (in/out, wire level), bundled cable channels, stored energy and fluids are printed in chat.
jei.redcircuit.info.solar_panel: Generates 10 FE/t during the day under open sky (less in rain).
jei.redcircuit.info.tube: Items find the nearest inventory that accepts them. Right-click with dye to paint: painted tubes only carry items of that colour. Shift + right-click with an empty hand removes paint.
jei.redcircuit.info.sorting_machine: Row 1: dye (colour given to items), rows 2-3: item patterns for that column. On a redstone pulse sends a matching stack into the tube in front.
jei.redcircuit.info.blueprint_table: Crafting table that keeps its 3x3 grid and has 18 storage slots; ingredients are taken from storage first. Put a Blank Plan in the left slot and press the button to save the recipe.
jei.redcircuit.info.blank_plan: Write a recipe onto it in the Blueprint Table.
jei.redcircuit.info.handsaw: Crafting tool: stays in the grid after crafting and loses 1 durability. Used to craft the Sawmill.
